sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface localisation confirmed by the design intent and use of the knock-in mouse for localisation studies; explicit electrophysiological functional assay not reported in the cited clips.
sites.rationale: [Literature audit 2026-11-05 (deliverome-analysis PR 236), verdict confirmed_exact: position confirmed at this residue. validation_level surface_only -> function_only (paper reports surface: not_reported, function: yes). Paper (PMID 29740340): "the HA tag was inserted in frame between residues D90 and V91 and rest of the channel open reading frame was identical to the known cDNA mouse sequence". Audit note: CRISPR knock-in of G-YPYDVPDYA in mouse Kir7.1 (P86046) between D90|V91; mouse MNGDLEIDHD|VPPENHT aligns to human MNGDLELDHD|APPENHT with zero offset, so human junction is D90|A91. Surface display inferred only from apical-membrane immunoreactivity in fixed tissue sections (no non-permeabilized assay). Function shown: Kir7.1-HA cDNA cloned from the knock-in gives native-like whole-cell and large Rb+ currents in HEK-293.] L1 and L2 both explicitly name the junction as between D90 and V91 in mouse Kir7.1, confirmed by sequencing. Python lookup of the human O60928 canonical sequence confirms D at position 90 and A at position 91 (a conservative V→A species substitution at the residue immediately after the junction, which does not affect the junction itself). Position 90 sits 13 residues from the TM1 C-terminal boundary (77) and 45 residues from the TM2 N-terminal boundary (135), well within the extracellular span (78–134) and safely beyond the ≥3-residue TM clearance requirement on both sides. CRISPR/Cas9 knock-in mouse (Kir7.1-HA) expressing endogenous mouse Kir7.1 with an HA epitope (G-YPYDVPDYA) inserted between residues D90 and V91 of the mouse sequence, confirmed by sequencing. The equivalent human junction is D90|A91 (mouse V91 is A91 in human O60928). The tag was placed in the predicted extracellular loop immediately after TM1, confirmed to face the extracellular surface.

sources.claim: The chromatogram in Figure 2A shows that the HA tag was inserted in frame between residues D90 and V91 and rest of the channel open reading frame was identical to the known cDNA mouse sequence (NCBI Reference Sequence: NM_001110227.2 ).
sources.title: Tissue Distribution of Kir7.1 Inwardly Rectifying K(+) Channel Probed in a Knock-in Mouse Expressing a Haemagglutinin-Tagged Protein
